items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: Ed Michel helped to institute some kind of program I believe to issue these records on Impulse

ctx.x: And he passed away not that long ago, a major, major important factor in jazz, I don’t know how often he’s been interviewed, I don’t really know what’s been written about him, but he is one of the heroes of jazz and record labels. He — I’m sure he was the one who encouraged Impulse, a division of ABC at that point, not an Indy anymore, to license Sun Ra recordings and make new Sun Ra recordings. And it wasn’t just Sun Ra, very important jazz figure. And by the way, Impulse for a while dallied with quadraphonic…
Well Jerry, we’ve been at this for like quite a while, how are you feeling about it?
